Payment Request Management – Allow to create the multiple supplier Payment request

## Business Requirement
The Finance and Merchandising teams require the ability to create a single payment request for multiple suppliers by selecting outstanding invoices from the system. Currently, payment requests must be created individually per supplier, which increases manual effort and processing time.

## Purpose
The purpose of this feature is to streamline the payment request process by allowing users to select invoices from multiple suppliers and generate one consolidated payment request number that can be forwarded to the Finance team for payment processing.

## Scope
• Users will be able to select multiple supplier invoices from the invoice list.
• Selected invoices may belong to different suppliers.
• The system will generate one Payment Request Number covering all selected invoices.
• The payment request will then be shared with the Finance team for payment release and tracking

## Solution
The system will introduce a Payment Request Creation option in the invoice management screen with the following functionality:
Above image is the reference how to consolidate the multiple invoices belongs to various supplier into one payment request.
• Single Payment Request Number based on System Coding.
• Reference Number for Payment request
• Payment Request date.
• Import & Export functionality to create the Payment Request Via Excel import using a template.

## Acceptance Criteria:
• Users can select multiple invoices across different suppliers.
• System generates a single Payment Request Number for the selected invoices.
• Selected invoices are linked to the created payment request.
• Finance team can view and process payment requests from the system.
• The system prevents duplicate payment requests for the same invoice.
• Payment request status can be tracked until payment completion.
